freedom.title: Financial Freedom
freedom.text: Your money works harder than you do now. You choose your mornings. You say no to things. In Abuja, that is the rarest luxury of all.

grass.title: Grass to Grace
grass.text: From garri without sugar in Nyanya to owning your own future. Nobody handed you anything. The Lapo Baby made it, and every Lapo Baby watching knows it can be done.

jail.title: Jailed for Fraud
jail.text: The Benz, the clubs, the 'clients'. It all ended in a cell at Kuje. Slim's number no longer connects.

ninefive.title: Stuck in a 9-5
ninefive.text: Salary comes, salary goes. You are not broke. You are not free. You are tired, stable, and wondering what would have happened if you had taken that one risk.

broke.title: Broke
broke.text: The loans, the flexing, the bad bets, the black tax. Abuja took more than it gave. You end with nothing but stories and a phone full of QuickKash messages.

japa.title: Japa
japa.text: Boarding pass in hand, Nnamdi Azikiwe Airport behind you. A new country, new cold, new hustle. You will send money home. You will miss suya forever.

cut.title: Life Cut Short
cut.text: Some stories end before they should. In a city of big dreams, safety is still a privilege. Rest well.
